title: Grounding
description: The live Pellier path grounds recommendations in Aurora data: product_catalog for products, inventory/quantity fields for availability, return policy tables for support, and pgvector/FTS for retrieval.
codeSnippet:
# Ground a recommendation in catalog rows
SELECT product_id, name, brand, price, quantity
FROM product_catalog
WHERE quantity > 0
ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector
LIMIT 5;

title: Memory
role: Four memory types; operational history stays evidence
description: Working memory holds session turns. Semantic memory holds durable learned preferences. Episodic memory comes from customer events in Aurora. Procedural knowledge comes from checked-in runtime skills and MCP schemas. tool_audit is shown separately because it proves what ran; it does not teach the agent how to work.
codeSnippet:
# Working - AgentCore Memory session events
await memory.append_session_turns(session_ns, turns)

# Semantic - AgentCore USER_PREFERENCE records
prefs = await memory.get_semantic_memories(actor_id)

# Episodic - Aurora customer events
seed = await fetch_episodic_seed(customer_id)

# Procedural - reviewable source
skills/*/SKILL.md
scripts/deploy/gateway_tool_schemas.py

# Operational history - evidence, not memory
SELECT tool, count(*), avg(latency_ms)
FROM pellier.tool_audit
GROUP BY tool;

title: Skills
role: Persona and proof instructions loaded per turn
description: Five skills are loaded by the SkillRouter when a turn needs specific handling: three persona overlays plus the shared Care Card and Proof Counter. They shape voice, care handling, and proof language; they do not change the database contract.
codeSnippet:
# SkillRouter may load persona or shared overlays
skills = route_skills(query, persona)
prompt += inject_loaded_skills(skills)

title: Routing & State
role: Dispatcher storefront plus bounded operator graph
description: Pellier uses two explicit production paths. The Storefront deterministically routes one turn to one specialist. Operator Concierge runs Case Investigator then Resolution Planner in a Strands graph. Agents-as-Tools remains a comparison pattern. PostgreSQL persists the review checkpoint outside both invocations.
codeSnippet:
# Storefront
intent = classify_intent(query)
return await run_dispatcher_pattern(intent, skills, query)

# Operator Concierge
builder.add_node(investigator, 'case-investigator')
builder.add_node(planner, 'resolution-planner')
builder.add_edge('case-investigator', 'resolution-planner')

title: Runtime Envelope
role: Bounded invocations; durable state between them
description: AgentCore Runtime is the deployment target for both the Storefront Dispatcher and Operator Concierge graph. Each invocation finishes and persists its result. PostgreSQL holds the pending review, exact action hash, human decision, and execution receipts between requests; Runtime never waits for a person.
codeSnippet:
# Storefront invocation
request -> dispatcher -> specialist/tool -> response

# Operator invocation
request -> investigator -> planner -> persisted artifact

# Between invocations
PostgreSQL review -> human decision -> governed execution request

title: Evaluations
description: Evaluation cards are the owned quality layer: latency, relevance, grounding, and scenario checks for the three workshop capabilities. They are not the request path; they are how the team decides whether a path is worth shipping.
codeSnippet:
# Evaluation scorecard shape
scorecard = {
    'capability': 'agentic (Sonnet → filter → vector → rerank)',
    'recall_at_5': 0.96,
    'latency_p50_ms': 2300,
    'grounded': true
}

title: Tool Registry
description: The Aurora tool registry is the live workshop teaching surface for semantic discovery. Tool descriptions are embedded with Cohere Embed v4 (1024-dim) and ranked by cosine similarity. Local Dispatcher turns call the checked-in Strands tools; managed Dispatcher turns discover the corresponding MCP tools through AgentCore Gateway.
codeSnippet:
# Discover by semantic similarity
SELECT name,
       1 - (embedding <=> $1) AS similarity
FROM pellier.tools
ORDER BY embedding <=> $1
LIMIT 5;

title: MCP Gateway
role: Required managed tool rail in the governed format
description: AgentCore Gateway publishes Pellier's 17 tools over MCP. Governed Runtime requests require this managed rail and fail closed when it is unavailable; the separate builders format retains in-process Strands tools.
codeSnippet:
# Governed requests fail closed without Gateway
if WORKSHOP_FORMAT == "governed":
    require(AGENTCORE_GATEWAY_URL)
    tools = await mcp_client.list_tools()
    result = await mcp_client.call_tool(name, args)
else:
    result = await strands_dispatch(name, args)
